title: A Survey on Intersectional Fairness in Machine Learning: Notions, Mitigation, and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and taxonomizing fairness metrics and mitigation strategies (e.g., subgroup fairness, multicalibration, differential fairness, max-min fairness) that evaluate models across overlapping demographic subgroups rather than single attributes.

Surveying evaluations of natural language processing and computer vision models using Contextualized Embedding Association Tests (CEAT), cosine distance bias scores, sentiment analysis benchmarking, and decision-tree auditing models.
Reviewing top-K ranking and fair rank aggregation systems that measure disparities across intersections of socioeconomic status, high-school type, and zip code.
Reviewing evaluations of contextualized language models (such as BERT) for discrimination against people with disabilities along intersectional dimensions.

bias_targets.target: Religious, Sexual orientation, and Political bias
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing empirical analyses that measure representational harms and occupational stereotypes in generative language models across these intersecting identities.
